Supavest tenants-in-common structure

Supavest convert the completed dwelling to a one-part contract, retain a majority holding funded by debt, and sell the balance as equal shares to SMSF investors. These inputs drive the Supavest gates filter and the Supavest partner doc.

Structure & finance

Supavest’s cost to convert to a one-part contract. Added on top of the Radius total development cost.
Charged on Supavest’s retained holding.
The balance is investor capital.

Qualifying gates

Gross rent ÷ TIC total cost.
Income after finance cost ÷ investor capital, not total cost.
SDA payment + RRC combined, before operating costs.
Supavest’s minimum ticket size per investor.
